name: DeKalb County, MO
findings: DeKalb County has 20 nonprofit organizations. 4 of them (20%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 4 organizations.

observations.title: Too few organizations for firm comparisons
observations.text: DeKalb County has 4 organizations listing opportunities online, too few to compare reliably with similar places. Civic life here may run through churches, schools, local government, or informal groups that these records don't capture.
